name: What factors determine the cost of storm-related painting and finish repairs?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of storm-related painting and finish repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: The total cost depends on the extent of structural intrusion, drywall replacement needs, and trim details. Surface-only repairs, like sealing minor water spots and repainting a single room, cost substantially less than projects requiring cut-outs, mold remediation, insulation replacement, and new drywall finishing. If hail or wind-driven rain damaged window casings, baseboards, or specialty trim, custom finish carpentry will increase the overall scope. The exact price is determined after assessing whether the project involves simple cosmetic repainting or integrated drywall, texture matching, and millwork replacement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on whether repairs are purely cosmetic or require cutting out water-logged drywall, replacing insulation, matching wall textures, and rebuilding damaged trim.
